item.title: Anomaly Detection System for Telephone Network Subscribers
item.description: A new issue of the KPI Bulletin on Computer Engineering was published featuring my research paper (co-authored with P. N. Malyukov): Malyukov P. N., Rader R. I. Anomaly Detection System for Telephone Network Subscribers. Bulletin of NTUU “KPI”. Informatics, Control and Computer Science: Collection of Scientific Papers. – Kyiv: Vek+, 2013. – No. 59. – pp. 106–110. Abstract An algorithm and system for detecting anomalous behavior of subscribers considering group behavior changes are proposed.
